# We Are Teachers

> A comprehensive community platform providing educators with lesson plans, classroom activities, teaching resources, and exclusive deals to inspire and support effective instruction across all grade levels.

We Are Teachers is a trusted resource hub for K-12 educators offering curated lesson plans, hands-on activities, free printables, and teacher-endorsed products. The site combines practical classroom resources with community features like giveaways, teacher discounts, and inspiration from experienced educators.

## Key Topics

- Lesson Plans
- Classroom Activities
- Grade Level Resources
- STEM & Science Education
- Art & Creativity
- Free Printables
- Teacher Discounts & Deals
- Hands-On Activities
- Elementary School
- High School
- Professional Development
- School Culture
- Teacher Picks
- Holiday & Seasonal Activities
- Interactive Games

## Grade Level Resources

- [Grades K-5](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/k-5): Resource hub for K-5 grades with lesson plans and classroom activities.
- [Elementary School](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/elementary-school): Elementary school resource hub with worksheets and classroom activities.
- [Grades 6-12](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/6-12): Resource hub for grades 6-12 with lesson plans and subject guides.
- [High School](https://www.weareteachers.com/grades/high-school): High school teaching resources with lesson plans and classroom guidance.

## Hands-On Learning Activities

- [70 Free Directed Drawing Activities for Kids](https://www.weareteachers.com/directed-drawing-activities): 70 free step-by-step directed drawing activities for all grade levels.
- [30 Hands-On Circulatory System Activities for Kids](https://www.weareteachers.com/circulatory-system-activities): 30 hands-on circulatory system activities for elementary science classes.
- [Game Hub](https://www.weareteachers.com/hub/online-activities-for-students): Interactive games and brain teasers for student learning and engagement.

## Subject & Topic Resources

- [Science Education](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/science): Science education resources with hands-on activities and STEM lessons.
- [Art & Creativity](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/arts): Art and creativity resources with projects and craft ideas for classrooms.
- [Holidays & Seasons](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/holidays-seasons): Seasonal and holiday classroom activities, crafts, and lesson resources.
- [Women's History Month Activities for All Ages](https://www.weareteachers.com/womens-history-month-activities): Women's History Month activities and free printables for classrooms.
- [School Culture & Colleagues](https://www.weareteachers.com/topics/school-culture-colleagues): Resources on school culture, teacher appreciation, and classroom community.

## Teacher Picks & Reviews
